classification.difficultyReason: Use equal opposite sides to form equations and solve for two pronumerals.

content.prompt: Find the values of $x$ and $y$ in the rectangle shown.

spec.sourceRegion: Question 18 rectangle beneath the prompt, on the left.
spec.description: Unfilled rectangle with 2x + 3 above, 10 below, 3y on the left and 6 on the right; matching double ticks on horizontal sides, single ticks on vertical sides and four right-angle markers.
spec.mathematics: Opposite sides are equal: 3y = 6 and 2x + 3 = 10. Drawing coordinates reproduce the schematic proportions and are not additional numerical givens.
spec.answerVisibility: All side labels and geometric marks are permanent givens. No solved values appear in the question diagram.

answer.worked:
Opposite sides of a rectangle are equal.

$$\begin{align*}3y &= 6 \\ y &= 2\end{align*}$$

$$\begin{align*}2x+3 &= 10 \\ 2x &= 7 \\ x &= 3.5\end{align*}$$

Check: $3(2)=6$ and $2(3.5)+3=10$.
